scope: CPU-only standalone closure pilot; no production integration, default change, GPU run, or large-supercell execution.

method.reciprocal_translation: u=exp(-i k.r) phi; IFFT[exp(-i G.tau) FFT(u)]; phi_tau=exp(-i k.tau) exp(+i k.r) u_tau
method.target_grid_closure: evaluate the primitive seed and reciprocal translation on the commensurate 2x mesh, then select the target-grid lattice points
method.not_claimed: The 2x mesh is a convergence closure, not an exact interpolation theorem or production selector design.

target_grid_parity.metric_assembly: all complex AO-group contributions are summed before abs-squared

on_demand_measurement.definition: Each pivot-column group request regenerates its translated 2x-grid AO group; no cached generated group is reused.

conclusion: The 2x commensurate closure removes the target-grid aliasing observed at 1x for this pilot and reproduces target-grid AO, three metric columns, and the rank-16 deterministic pivot prefix. The measured pivot path really regenerates groups and retains at most one or two 2x AO groups, but its 444 byte projection and the unchanged dense-L requirement do not justify production integration.
